summary.text: Todd Hunter is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 32 since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously held the same seat from 1989 to 1997 and is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Todd Hunter earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas and a law degree from Southern Methodist University.
He is a senior partner in the law firm Hunter, Barker & Fancher, LLP, and has been a practicing attorney since 1978.
Ballotpedia lists his civic involvement as including the Church of the Good Shepherd, the Coastal Bend Boy Scouts of America, the Corpus Christi Rotary Club, and the Texas Lyceum Association.
Hunter served in the Texas House from 1989 to 1997 and returned to the seat in 2009; his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
He chaired the Calendars Committee in the 2011 through 2017 sessions and the Redistricting Committee in 2021-2022.
In 2023-2024 he chaired the House State Affairs Committee.
